description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/ddl-index-forms: WITH PRIMARY and DISALLOW NULL failed for other causes. Asks what CREATE INDEX ... WITH PRIMARY, DISALLOW NULL, IGNORE NULL and the two combined orders do, each on its own fresh table IxA to IxG (K Long, A Text(10), B Long; three rows; no Null except in IxG A; a primary key only on IxF), with dbFailOnError, Errors and the table's indexes (refreshed: Name, Primary, Unique, IgnoreNulls, Required, Clustered). WITH PRIMARY twice is IxA, over an existing key IxF, DISALLOW NULL over a Null is IxG. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
